title: Recall Desk study starter — starter demonstration
description: Authoring starter with one labeled demonstration question. Replace it before using this as a real diagnostic.
instructions: Replace all demonstration content before study. Record K (can explain), R (reasoned but uncertain), or G (guess/elimination), familiarity, and any outside help. You may pause between sections. No official timing or pass threshold is assumed.
sourceCatalog: Add source identifiers, exact URLs/document names, versions, and sections here. Do not fabricate references.

questions.prompt: **Template demonstration — not a certification question.** What should you do before using this starter as a real practice assessment?

options.text: Replace the demonstration with source-backed questions and verify every answer.
options.explanation: The starter supplies structure. The actual subject content and answer evidence must be authored and checked.
Changing the title does not create questions that assess the new subject.

options.text: Reuse another certification’s objective weights without checking.
options.explanation: The objective map should come from the applicable current source.

options.text: Treat this demonstration score as proof of mastery.
options.explanation: This question checks how to use the template, not the subject being studied.

questions.explanation: Use exam.json as the single source of truth. The build command derives the candidate and answer key from it, checks references, and calculates document checksums.
